mentions.note: pictured (number 76) at Coulsdon; beat Martin Lake in the Club 10 mile Championship
new member; started with the Gorman pack; 2nd 61.33; 3rd handicap

mentions.h: 29th SEPTEMBER 1984 WIMBLEDON BELGRAVE 5¼ MILE ROAD RACE

photos.c: Len Best(76) and Martin Lake have both shown remarkable improvement through the winter and have never been far apart at the finish. In this race(The 4th Surrey CC League Match at Coulsdon) Martin turned out the winner but in the Club 10mile Championship Len got the better of Martin.
